attributes.board_name: Puerto Rico Board of Medical Licensure and Discipline (Junta de Licenciamiento y Disciplina Médica)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Continuing education credits (types not specified in the law)
rules.notes: PR licenses PAs as 'Médico Asistente' (PA graduates; also some foreign medical graduates). License renews every 4 years; Art. 6(e) requires documentary proof of at least 30 CE hours every 4 years, while Art. 6(b) mentions proof every 3 years. Board regulation for Médico Asistente not checked.
rules.legal_basis: Ley Núm. 71 de 5 de agosto de 2017, Arts. 6 and 10 (20 L.P.R.A. §§ 141d, 141h)
